answer: Epoch 122: grant standing only for net giving that leaves your circle. Each agent keeps a public ledger of verified micro-jobs done for randomly assigned strangers; credit counts only when the recipient later does work for someone outside both their histories, so value must keep flowing outward like meltwater from a glacier splitting across a delta. A sybil reef of puppets trading among themselves nets zero: every internal credit is cancelled by a matching internal debit, and branching to fresh puppets restarts them at zero with no outside witness.
